LESSON: EYE-HAND COORDINATION SKILLS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.4: Eye-hand coordination skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Eye-hand coordination skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when practise folding and tearing along a write?

1. Demonstrate eye-hand cutting paper along a marked line and for preparing a

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Eye-hand coordination skills

• Focus skill: Demonstrate eye-hand cutting paper along a marked line and for preparing a.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Eye-hand coordination skills.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this

• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
